plans.title: Transcript text precision: cue-writer Latin spacing, and the hotword benefit measured
notes: Adopted from iter-2026-09-residual-closeout (locked and review-chain-approved there, deferred when that iteration's scope was reduced). Closes R6 and R3. Task 2 runs a real-host GPU A/B (two arms, BV1H69sB6EeF:p0) as a decoding-configuration measurement.

Task 1 BLOCKED on evidence (NEEDS_CONTEXT at the plan's authorised Step-1 exit): the two-condition cue rule cannot be evaluated on any readable material — the archived payload stores only the pipeline's output, and the pinned fixture's 91 inserted spaces sit at 0 firing boundaries, making 'fixture byte-identical' a regression guard rather than evidence. PM decision 2026-09-18: do NOT land the rule; R6 stays open with its unblock recorded; this plan now closes R3 only. Nothing was changed, no green was manufactured.

Task 2 DONE (pending L2 review): the six Chinese homophone hotwords measured by a three-run A/B on the archive host. with(33) 扬弃 38 / homophones 26; without(27) 扬弃 4 / homophones 59 — the without arm reproduced the season baseline independently. A self-added same-config repeat run came out byte-identical (noise floor zero), so the 2.4751 % global difference (bar <=5 %) is attributable. Benefit is 扬弃's alone: the other five terms are inert on this lecture (unexercised, not refuted). R3 closable on this evidence; PM closes after L2.

Task 2 L2 review APPROVED (code-reviewer Mode A, {SDD_DIR}/20260918-transcript-text-precision/task-2-review.md): Spec Compliance compliant, 0 Critical / 0 Important / 3 Minor; no diff was owed (branch tip = BASE = 0fc963d). All 12 host-side warnings were resolved by the PM on the archive host with read-only reads — every headline number reproduced (md asr_hotwords 33/27/33, 扬弃 38 vs 4, homophones 26 vs 59, ratio 0.9752 exactly with difflib autojunk=False, cues 1400/1410, conf 0.751, low-conf 48/51, repeat byte-identical, 1275 shared buckets with 209 differing, driver sha256 match). R3 CLOSED 2026-09-18 (verified close) on the row's own target; its five unexercised terms are carried forward as successor row 20260918-transcript-text-precision · R1, so the open count is unchanged (medium 1 / low 7). The plan stays InProgress: plan QC tri-review and the QA gate are still owed before Done. Minors M1-M3 are in the SDD ledger under '## Minor (for plan QC)'.

Gates executed in order: per-task L2 review (Task 2 Approved; Task 1 retired on evidence with no change to review) -> plan QC tri-review Request Changes (6 Warnings) -> fix wave -> targeted re-review 2/2 Approve -> bounded confirmation -> mandatory QA gate Approve with residuals (8/8 acceptance criteria pass).
